author: GamingBolt
description:
1666: Amsterdam is a difficult game to recommend. The lack of polish, along with the incredibly dull combat system gets in the way of what is otherwise an interesting story with some fun character dynamics. Conversations between Noa and Aaron tend to be quite entertaining. 

Noa knows only the world of her own era, while Aaron comes from 1999, so there is a certain joy in hearing the two compare their versions of Amsterdam. 1666: Amsterdam will likely be quite a fun game with a compelling story once it exits Early Access. In the meantime, however, I’d recommend waiting.
title: 1666 Amsterdam Early Access Review - Needs More Time In The Oven

author: GamingBolt
description:
EA Sports NHL 27 isn’t content with a minor annual pass over the rink. This year’s version slapshots straight into how teams think, function, defend, and react, with every NHL team receiving an overhauled tactical identity.

Throw in smarter goalies, deliberate skating, and dynamically shifting strategies, plus a significantly enhanced broadcast package, and NHL 27 could be the most substantial evolution yet for EA’s long-running ice hockey sim.
title: EA Sports NHL 27 - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
The countdown to Marvel's Wolverine, with its action-packed take on the legendary anti-hero, continues, and we're stoked, to put it mildly. title: Marvel's Wolverine - 15 NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Pre-Order
